shared_elements: carved relief motifs in low relief
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief carving with an anthropomorphic presence, circular disc/rosette forms and horizontal dividing bands, but these are generic conventions found almost anywhere. A is a single blocky monolithic figure whose body bears abstract, schematic emblems (concentric circle, curved bands), while B is a naturalistic narrative frieze of men driving horned rams past a leafy tree above a rosette border — no shared scene, posture or relationship.
